items.snippet_en: PIB Fact Check states that a WhatsApp message claiming the government is providing free laptops under the 'National Student Laptop Scheme 2026' is fake and no such program has been announced by the Government of India.

items.title: Free Laptop Scheme 2026 Scam Alert: How To Verify Government Schemes And Protect Your Data From Fraud
items.snippet_en: Careerindia.com reports that a WhatsApp forward about a "Free Laptop Scheme 2026" is a scam, and no central laptop scheme has been announced. Legitimate national benefits would appear on official government portals (ending in .gov.in) and through Press Information Bureau updates.

items.title: Free Laptop Scheme For Students
items.snippet_en: Buddy4study.com mentions that while there is no central government free laptop scheme, several Indian states like Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh have their own programs for eligible students.
The Government of Goa has a "Laptop Scheme for Meritorious Students of SC/ST" as of September 18, 2026.
Pakistan also has a "PM's National Laptop Scheme" run by the Higher Education Commission (HEC).
The Higher Education Commission (HEC) in Pakistan runs the "PM's National Laptop Scheme."

items.title: Free Laptop Scheme 2026 Scam Alert: How To Verify Government Schemes And Protect Your Data From Fraud
items.snippet_en: Careerindia.com warns that scam messages about free laptop schemes often include "urgent application deadlines" to create panic.
A YouTube video from October 4, 2026, mentions a scholarship with an application deadline of October 15.
Another YouTube video from July 29, 2026, mentions a scholarship program with a deadline of July 30.

items.title: Laptop Scheme
items.snippet_en: The Asianet Laptop Scheme, for students in Kerala, has a submission deadline of March 31, 2027.
The Info Tech Corporation of Goa's Laptop Scheme for Meritorious Students of SC/ST announces its start and last dates for applications annually.

items.title: Free Laptop Scheme 2026 Scam Alert: How To Verify Government Schemes And Protect Your Data From Fraud
items.snippet_en: Careerindia.com states that scam forwards for free laptop schemes often use non-government URLs and advises checking for .gov.in domains for authentic notices.

items.title: Free Laptop Scheme For Students
items.snippet_en: Official government schemes, like those in Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh, do not involve direct student applications through such links; instead, colleges identify eligible students and upload their data to official systems.
The Press Information Bureau (PIB) has repeatedly debunked claims about a "PM Free Laptop Scheme," confirming them as scams designed to collect personal information.

items.title: Government refutes message of free laptop distribution under student laptop scheme 2026
items.snippet_en: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) advises citizens to verify news only from government sources.

outputs.notes_en: The claim about the 'Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026' is false. Multiple sources, including PIB Fact Check and Careerindia.com, confirm that no such central government scheme exists and that messages promoting it are scams. While some Indian states and Pakistan have their own laptop schemes, the specific scheme mentioned in the claim is not legitimate. The claim about an application deadline of October 15 is a common tactic used in scam messages to create urgency. The website www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in is not an official government domain, and official schemes do not use such direct application links.
